title: Group Anagrams

content.problemStatement:
Given an array of strings, group the anagrams together.

Return groups in any order.

sampleTestCases.input:
6
eat tea tan ate nat bat
sampleTestCases.output:
eat tea ate
tan nat
bat
sampleTestCases.explanation: Example demonstrating Group words by sorted character representation and output each group on a separate line.
